title: Patch
summary: A small patch with fresh release notes.

sections.heading: Fixes
items: The What's new popup shows once on the first load after an update, and stays under More > What's new.

title: Balance and fixes
summary: A balance and fixes release: tougher Cinderhoof, tuned commons and gear, and a refresh popup when the game updates.

sections.heading: Fixes
items: A popup now asks you to refresh when the game has been updated, and it checks when you return to an idle tab.
Admin always-catch now works on bosses immune to your armed trap type.
The Cheer Meter resets when you travel to another area.
Fixed leftover quiet-hunt wording and the Carol Loft hint (Carol Horn needs 5 Hymn Reeds).

sections.heading: Balance
items: Cinderhoof is much harder: about 25% to catch with the best gear.
Carol Horn needs luck 1, and luck only counts when your trap type matches the elf's weakness.
Commons and General Grimbolt tuned, with gold and points raised to keep pace. Recommended gear is now needed for each local boss.
Small buffs to the Wind-up Key Charm, Yule Log Base and Gingerbread Cottage.

title: Every hunt finds an elf
summary: The first full release. There are no quiet hunts any more: every hunt now attracts an elf and uses your bait.

sections.heading: Every hunt attracts an elf (Allure)
items: Quiet hunts are gone. Every hunt meets an elf and uses your bait.
Attraction is now called Allure. It sets how strongly your bait pulls rare elves, mini bosses and bosses.
The Silent Night badge now asks for 4 escapes in a row.
Rank 5 comes faster: about 1,200 hunts instead of about 1,650.

sections.heading: Cheer Meter, boons and Overcharge
items: Catches fill the Cheer Meter and escapes drain it. When it is full, pick 1 of 3 boons.
Hold on past full to Overcharge: two rare-or-better cards to choose from, plus a perk (a second pick, longer boons or two Santa's Blessings).
Three new Cheer charms fill the meter faster, and the Cheer card shows every buff and its hunts left.

sections.heading: Santa and Mrs. Claus
items: After a hunt, Santa or Mrs. Claus may step in with a boon, or a free rare Grand Gift. Santa's favour tracks how well you are doing.
Scrinch's random events were cut. He stays the villain of the story.

sections.heading: Toy Workshop and other areas
items: Toy Workshop orders now fill in parallel: every catch counts for the order of your armed trap's type, so no more swapping every hunt.
Madame Shredwell is much tougher without a Carol trap. Prepare before you face her.
Thieves often find no bait to steal, and crafted bait is almost safe.
Stables bosses are tougher, and Cinderhoof attacks only after your second launch.
Rank 5 now needs 217,000 points. The Cookie Pantry has a goals panel.

sections.heading: Naughty List and interface
items: The Naughty List opens on your current area and has an All tab, rarest first.
Uncaught elves now show their name and weakness.
The Wrapping Room bait ladder lets you browse tiers and jump to the Workshop recipe.
Hunt no longer scrolls away from your Cheer Meter. Rare and boss catches glow in the hunt log.
More > Feedback sends notes to the admin, and Start over never wipes them.
